_comment: GTFS-realtime feed registry. Each feed is an independent module: add a city by appending an entry + a routes lookup in data/static/. Feeds verified 2026-10-09 (see DATA_SOURCES.md).

feeds.license: MBTA GTFS-RT is published openly by the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority.
feeds.notes: Occupancy populated on buses; rail/ferry report NO_DATA_AVAILABLE. No delay fields published.

feeds.license: RTD GTFS-RT is published openly by the Regional Transportation District.
feeds.notes: Occupancy populated fleet-wide. ~15% of vehicles report no trip (deadheading).

feeds.license: HSL / Digitransit realtime API is published openly.
feeds.notes: Occupancy on ~1/3 of vehicles (buses/trams); rail reports NO_DATA_AVAILABLE.

feeds.license: TTC GTFS-Realtime is published openly, no key required.
feeds.notes: Occupancy fleet-wide (~98%). Bus + streetcar only; subway not published in RT.

feeds.license: MARTA GTFS-RT is published openly, no key required.
feeds.notes: Occupancy on ~60% of vehicles. Bus only.
